plugin.mixer.shift_aria: SHIFT: inputs {r} shown, tap for the next page
plugin.mixer.advisory.slice_late: Inputs {entrees} chronically late: put them in a 1-frame delay group (Inputs & delays tab), or set the default delay to “Fixed, 1 frame”
plugin.mixer.advisory.missing_frames_rep: Inputs {entrees}: missing source frames were replaced by their last valid frame (repeat) — the source skips frames; see counters missing_frames_repeated and invalid_grains
type.mixer.cfg.missing_frame_mode.label: Missing frame
type.mixer.cfg.missing_frame_mode.help: What the mixer composes when an input frame is missing (a hole in the source, e.g. a capture one slot late): “repeat” = that input's last valid frame (operation, invisible on air, counted in missing_frames_repeated); “black” = black (commissioning, to see when it skips). Empty = follows the global setting Settings → Video. Resolved at RENDER time by the orchestrator (missing_frame_mode_effective), applied live without restart.
plugin.mixer.dl_def_needs: #{i} ({src}) needs {d}: put it in a group, or set the default delay to “Fixed, 1 frame” (⚙).
plugin.mixer.dl_help: Each input is read at the frame “now − its delay”. Inputs of a group are aligned together; an input without a group follows the default delay. The program carries the frame number of the reference group, which does not change when cutting. “Needs” is measured continuously: an input that needs more than its delay shows its last frame.
plugin.mixer.dl_no_slice: Delays and groups apply in slice mode. This mixer runs whole-frame: it keeps the former behaviour (reference input).
plugin.mixer.dl_nogroups: No group: every input follows the default delay.
plugin.mixer.dl_rename_tip: Edit the name: the group's inputs and delay are kept
plugin.mixer.dl_err_name_taken: this name is already used by another group
plugin.mixer.dl_stale: The deployed engine does not know delays: redeploy the container.
plugin.mixer.k_auto_tip: Keyer mix over its own duration
plugin.mixer.k_legacy: The deployed engine knows a single keyer without key cut: redeploy the container for linear and luma keyers.
plugin.mixer.k_onair_tip: On / off air, without a transition
plugin.mixer.k_paste_none: Nothing to paste: copy a keyer first.
plugin.mixer.k_paste_tip: Paste the copied settings (type, inputs, position, mask, key, duration, clean — never on-air state)
plugin.mixer.k_presets_stale: Copy/paste and saved keyers: redeploy the container.
plugin.mixer.k_row_fill_tip: Show this keyer's source row on the panel
plugin.mixer.k_row_key_tip: Show this keyer's key row on the panel (linear)
plugin.mixer.k_chroma_assumed: Colorimetry not declared: the key colour is converted with BT.709.
plugin.mixer.tally_emit: Emit tally for the sources on screen (keyers included)
plugin.mixer.tally_force: Emit even when my output is not on air
plugin.mixer.wipe_hint: Pattern, direction and softness: choose the Wipe type.
type.mixer.cfg.dissolve_ms.label: Default dissolve (ms)
type.mixer.cfg.latency_mode.help: Fixed, 1 frame (default): every input without a group is read at the frame of the previous slot; the delay is constant and every source arrives in time. Fastest: the frame of the current slot, from its first lines; a late source shows its last frame. Delay groups are set in the Inputs & delays tab.
type.mixer.cfg.latency_mode.label: Default delay
type.mixer.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.mixer.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.mixer.cfg.n_inputs.help: 1 to 20 inputs. Unused slots cost nothing (the mixer only reads PGM, PVW, the keyer and the destination of a transition). An ATEM panel only addresses the inputs covered by its bus buttons (8 on most models).
type.mixer.cfg.n_inputs.label: Number of inputs
type.mixer.cfg.n_keyers.help: Upstream keyers (inside the M/E, like an ATEM's USKs): 1 to 4, composited over the background, below the DSKs, keyer 1 at the bottom. Each has its type (dve, linear, luma, chroma, pattern, web page), its inputs, its mask and position, its ON AIR and its AUTO, and can be targeted by the transition. An off-air keyer costs nothing; a full-frame cut keyer adds a few milliseconds per 1080p frame. Changing this number requires a redeploy.
type.mixer.cfg.n_keyers.label: Number of keyers
type.mixer.cfg.overlay_enabled.label: HTML overlay (DSK)
type.mixer.cfg.overlay_url.label: Overlay URL
type.mixer.cfg.slice_late_pct.help: Whole-frame fallback rate (~10 s window) above which an input is flagged (advisory). Blocks nothing and degrades nothing: it reports, the operator decides.
type.mixer.cfg.slice_late_pct.label: Fallback alert threshold (%)
type.mixer.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.mixer.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.mixer.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour. Requires genlock.
type.mixer.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.mixer.cfg.tally_emit.help: Publishes the mixer tally on a tally level (default: the project's). Sources are identified by the project ports.
type.mixer.cfg.tally_emit.label: Emit tally (PGM/PVW)
type.mixer.cfg.tally_force.help: Unticked, this mixer only tallies its inputs when its own PGM output carries a tally on its production's levels — that is normal tally propagation. Ticked (the default), it emits unconditionally: the historical behaviour, kept so as not to switch off the tally of a site whose mixer output is mapped nowhere. ⚠ Read by the ORCHESTRATOR (TSL service), never by the container: it applies hot, with no redeploy.
type.mixer.cfg.tally_force.label: Emit even when my output is not on air
type.mixer.cfg.tally_level_base.help: Which levels this mixer publishes its inputs' tally on — a level is a NAMED entity of the site (Settings → Labels & Tally), not a protocol band number. Several choices are possible. No choice = those of the container's production. ⚠ Read by the ORCHESTRATOR (TSL service), never by the container: it applies hot, with no redeploy.
type.mixer.cfg.tally_level_base.label: Tally level (base, empty = project)
type.mixer.label: Mixer
plugin.mixer.wipe_hint2: Wipe softness: choose the Wipe type in the transition block.
plugin.mixer.duration_si_tip: Duration in seconds:frames ("1:12"), or a number of frames
plugin.mixer.dl_arr_aria: Usual arrival {med} ms, worst case {max} ms, deadline {dl} ms
plugin.mixer.dl_arr_help: Arrival: the dot marks the usual arrival of the first slice within its frame's slot (X), the bar extends to the worst case of the last 4 seconds, the line marks the deadline of its delay. Dot before the line: the input is waited for; after it: it goes out with its previous frame.
plugin.mixer.dl_col_upstream_tip: How late the content already is when it arrives (RF camera, link, external processing), in frames: the input is read that much more recent than its group
plugin.mixer.dl_upstream_help: Upstream: a source whose content already arrives late (RF camera, link, external processing) is realigned here. It is read that much more recent than its group, which must therefore offer at least “measured need + upstream”. The displayed Need includes it.
plugin.mixer.out_help: PGM carries every keyer on air; the CLEAN output only those lit here.
plugin.mixer.out_always: {o} always carries the keyers on air
plugin.mixer.wipe_repeat_tip: Linear: number of bands (blinds). Shapes: N × N grid.
plugin.mixer.wipe_symmetry_tip: Linear: starts at the centre towards both edges (sliding door). Clock: two hands.
plugin.mixer.wipe_border_soft_in_tip: Border edge on the side of the outgoing source
plugin.mixer.wipe_border_soft_out_tip: Border edge on the side of the incoming source
plugin.mixer.comp_chip_tip: The next wipe is this composite wipe — tap to edit it
plugin.mixer.comp_need_name: Give the composite wipe a name.
plugin.mixer.comp_none: No composite wipe on this mixer.
plugin.mixer.comp_recall_tip: The next transition (Wipe) will be this composite wipe, as saved
plugin.mixer.k_pattern_bsi_tip: Outer edge of the border, background side
plugin.mixer.k_pattern_bso_tip: Fill edge; replaces the pattern softness when there is a border
plugin.mixer.dsk_auto_tip: Fade the DSK over its own duration
plugin.mixer.dsk_cut_tip: On air / off air, without a transition
plugin.mixer.dsk_help: Composited after the transition, above every keyer, never on the CLEAN output. TIE: it goes with the next background transition.
plugin.mixer.dsk_tie_tip: Tied: comes in or goes out with the next background transition
plugin.mixer.err_web_limit: Web layers: at most {max} on this mixer — remove the page of another layer first.
plugin.mixer.out_dsk_never: A DSK is never on the {o} output
type.mixer.cfg.n_dsk.help: Downstream keyers (DSK, as on an ATEM): 0 to 2, composited after the transition, above every keyer, never on the CLEAN output. Each has its type (dve, linear, luma, chroma, pattern, web page), its CUT, its AUTO and its TIE (it goes with the next background transition). The former HTML overlay is DSK 1, of type web page. Changing this number requires a redeploy.
type.mixer.cfg.n_dsk.label: Number of DSKs
type.mixer.cfg.overlay_enabled.help: Former overlay setting, kept for compatibility: it is DSK 1's on-air state. It is now set from the mixer panel (DSK row).
type.mixer.cfg.overlay_url.help: Former overlay setting, kept for compatibility: it is the page URL of DSK 1 (web page type). It is now set in the layer settings.
type.mixer.cfg.web_layers_max.help: Number of web-page layers (keyers and DSKs) WITH a URL this mixer accepts: each one is a tab of the container's browser, captured continuously. Beyond that, the setting is refused.
type.mixer.cfg.web_layers_max.label: Maximum web layers
plugin.mixer.web_unavailable: No browser in the container image: the page cannot be rendered.
plugin.mixer.out_help_multi: Background, transition and layer states are shared; each output picks its own layers.
plugin.mixer.out_shape_help: Adding, renaming or removing an output, or the PVW, restarts the mixer: the programme drops for a few seconds. The name gives the stream: <host>_<name>.
plugin.mixer.out_confirm_msg: The mixer will restart: the programme drops for a few seconds.
plugin.mixer.out_applied: Outputs saved — the mixer is restarting.
plugin.mixer.lib_common_hint: Shared by every mixer of the installation. Recalling one copies it into this mixer.
plugin.mixer.lib_delete_msg: Remove “{name}” from the shared library? Mixers that use it keep their copy.
plugin.mixer.lib_empty: The shared library is empty: “Add to the library”, in the editor, puts one of this mixer's wipes there.
plugin.mixer.lib_err_local_full: this mixer already holds its maximum number of composite wipes.
plugin.mixer.lib_err_name_taken_local: a different wipe of this mixer is already named “{name}”: rename it first.
plugin.mixer.lib_err_unknown_composite: wipe not found in this mixer (save it first).
plugin.mixer.lib_err_unknown_save: this wipe is no longer in the library.
plugin.mixer.lib_next_tip: Copies this wipe into this mixer and makes it the next transition (Wipe)
plugin.mixer.lib_replace_msg: The shared library already has a wipe “{name}”. Replace it with this mixer's? Mixers that already recalled it keep their copy.
plugin.mixer.lib_share_tip: Puts this wipe into the shared library as SAVED in this mixer (not the draft being edited)
plugin.mixer.lib_tag_gone_tip: Copy of a wipe since removed from the shared library: it stays here.
plugin.mixer.wiz.applied_restart: Configuration applied — the mixer is restarting.
plugin.mixer.wiz.banner_x: it runs with the default values.
plugin.mixer.wiz.confirm_cut: The air will be cut for a few seconds.
plugin.mixer.wiz.confirm_reset: Outputs stop, then the on-air state starts over (selections, keyers and DSKs on air).
plugin.mixer.wiz.ctx_empty: Touch an element of the diagram to set it: the inputs, a layer, an output, the PVW or the panel. The transition is set during operation. “＋” adds; an output's pills include or exclude a layer.
plugin.mixer.wiz.dsk_help: After the transition, on top of everything. Its own CUT and AUTO.
plugin.mixer.wiz.first_note: nothing on air, applying cuts nothing
plugin.mixer.wiz.genlock: Frame rate locked to a reference input (genlock)
plugin.mixer.wiz.inputs_cabling: Sources are wired on the Cables page; delay groups in the Inputs & delays tab.
plugin.mixer.wiz.keyer_help: Upstream keyer, in the M/E: goes through the transition.
plugin.mixer.wiz.lead_first: The guide suggests a few small steps on the diagram; you can also touch any element directly.
plugin.mixer.wiz.lead_live: Touch an element to change it. Settings marked ↻ restart the mixer; the others apply live.
plugin.mixer.wiz.legend_help: The background runs inputs → BGD A / B → transition; layers stack above it and take their sources straight from the inputs, through the vertical bundle — dashed: key of a linear keyer. Filled pill = layer shown on that output; red dot = counts for tally.
plugin.mixer.wiz.out_cpu: each output with a different composition costs processing
plugin.mixer.wiz.out_rename_help: changing case or accents is applied live; another name changes the stream and disconnects its subscribers
plugin.mixer.wiz.out_tally_help: A source visible on this output lights its PGM tally.
plugin.mixer.wiz.panel_no_right: Assigning a panel requires the right to edit settings: Settings → ATEM panels.
plugin.mixer.wiz.panel_none: No known ATEM panel: it appears as soon as it connects (Settings → ATEM panels).
plugin.mixer.wiz.pvw_base_help: PVW shows the next frame of this output.
plugin.mixer.wiz.pvw_help: Preview: the next frame of a program output.
plugin.mixer.wiz.rb_title: Changing this setting restarts the mixer
plugin.mixer.wiz.sch_aria: Mixer diagram, touch an element to set it
plugin.mixer.wiz.sch_keyers: KEYERS — over the background, inside the transition
plugin.mixer.wiz.shift_16: Inputs 17 and above: from the interface only.
plugin.mixer.wiz.shift_help: The 8 bus buttons switch to inputs 9 to 16 while Shift is active. The panel's own SHIFT key also works if its Button Mapping puts 9-16 on its Shift page.
plugin.mixer.wiz.shift_key: MACRO key acting as Shift (0 = none)
plugin.mixer.wiz.src_help: Taken directly from the inputs, independently of BGD A / B.
plugin.mixer.wiz.title: Mixer setup assistant
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_done_d: Next: wire the inputs on the Cables page. The assistant reopens from ⚙ → Assistant.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_inputs_d: Touch the inputs block. A non-synchronous source (RF camera, link…) goes into a delay group. Sources are then wired on the Cables page.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_inputs_t: How many inputs, which format? Are your sources synchronous?
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_layers_d: They stack over the background. Keyer: inside the transition. DSK: on top of everything. Touch a layer for its type and sources, taken from the inputs.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_outs_d: Each output picks its layers: touch its pills. 4 outputs at most. PVW is based on one of them.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_outs_t: One output per use: air, clean, web…
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_panel_d: Optional. Everything can be found later in Settings.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tour_panel_t: ATEM panel and tally: now or later?
plugin.mixer.wiz.waiting_x: {h} is not configured yet. A user allowed to deploy prepares it when first opening it.
plugin.mixer.wiz.web_cpu: costs CPU: one Chromium tab per “web page” layer
plugin.mixer.wiz.lib_pending: Apply or discard your changes first.
plugin.mixer.wiz.tr_ops_aria: Transition: set during operation, Transitions section
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_x: A synchronous source (same PTP reference) arrives in time for the default delay. One that is not (RF camera, link, external processing) arrives later: put it in a delay group, otherwise it goes through with its previous frame.
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_whole: This mixer runs in whole-frame mode: delays and groups only apply in slice mode (Settings → Video). In whole-frame mode, the alignment wait (Advanced) plays that role.
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_nogroup: none — every input follows the default delay
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_old: The deployed engine does not measure lateness yet: it will show after the next redeployment.
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_late: Late on the default delay: {i}. They go through with their previous frame.
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_ok: Measured: no ungrouped input is late.
plugin.mixer.wiz.sync_unwired: Nothing wired: measuring starts once inputs are wired.
plugin.mixer.sync_banner_x: {i} arrive(s) after the default delay and go(es) through with the previous frame. Put them in a delay group.
plugin.mixer.dve_aria: Placement of the DVE layers in the output picture
plugin.mixer.dve_hint: Tap a DVE to adjust it · Shift or Ctrl+click (or “Multiple selection”): several, the reference is the last one touched · bottom-right corner: size at the source's aspect ratio (Alt or “From centre”: around the centre) · arrows: 1 output pixel (Shift: 10).
plugin.mixer.dve_snap_tip: Snaps to the frame's edges and centre and to the other DVEs; arrow keys bypass it.
